label: Early copy-phase steps of very short sequences (L=3 copy steps; L=4 second-to-last output)
explanation: Active only in the copy phase, never during original input or on the <DEL> step. Fires on about 94% of copy steps in L=3 sequences (outputting orig(1) and orig(2)). These steps hold about 60% of activation mass and include the strongest activations, with the recall_idx=2 step (final output) strongest. It also fires on roughly 30% of L=4 recall_idx=2 steps (the second-to-last output), where firing depends on token identity: higher when the input is r/k/p/a. There is a weaker tail on long sequences (L=9, around recall_idx 2, t=11-12, and the last step t=17). It never fires when the input is the first occurrence of its token, and it is weaker when the sequence has more digits. It is silent on mid-copy steps of L=5-8 sequences. Magnitude is tiny overall (max 0.003).
